correctness.rationale: For every p in (0,1), q in (0,1), factorization gives canonical b_n=3q^n-2Re(w^n)>q^n>0. By the classical criterion, all-thinning decomposability is equivalent to b_n-b_(n+1)≥0. A uniform modulus inequality makes every difference positive at p≥4/9; for every 0<p<4/9 an index n~arctan(sqrt(s))/(sqrt(s)(1-q)) forces a strictly negative limiting normalized difference. Both pure NB endpoints are checked separately. Exact-rational formal division and independent root multiplication corroborate a finite witness at p=1/5,q=99/100 without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The shape-three extension is a natural and analytically distinct first conjugate-root case of geometric/gamma count mixtures. The exact uniform robustness boundary identifies which overdispersed marginals support stationary Bernoulli-thinning count autoregressions for every retention rate, while ordinary infinite divisibility alone does not. The isolated pure component and a failure visible only at growing canonical index give structurally meaningful nonroutine information.
